metadata.title: शराब की पहली धार, जाती है आर-पार | Why did Nisha quit making Desi Sharab
metadata.description:
In tribal communities, alcohol is associated with social and religious beliefs. Tribals offer liquor to their deities. The tribals make liquor at home. Tribal women are experts in making liquor. But the liquor made by women also creates trouble for women only. This is revealed from the story of Nisha.
